topic: Review: Review the finished reference evidence research in specs/system-skilled-bots/002-openbot-parity-research/004-reference-evidence-research/research/: the synthesis research.md, its regrade-log.md and the 40 iteration records under research/lineages/. Check that each recommendation is backed by the reference and plan lines it cites, that grades are right, that rejected findings were rightly rejected, that no well-supported finding was missed, and that recommendations do not contradict each other, the packet decisions or the licence rules. Read-only against the research, the 003 build plan and the reference repos.
